description: (Na)₂RbAlF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a RbAlF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the RbAlF₆ framework, Rb is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form RbF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Rb-F bond lengths are 2.54 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent RbF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Al-F bond lengths are 1.80 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Rb and one Al atom.
